# Graviton
**A curated performance & quality-of life focused modpack.**

Graviton is an (opinionated) basic collection of optimization, quality-of-life and general purpose mods that I use to play the game on a daily basis. The aim of this modpack is to allow players to play with the standard "Vanilla+" modded experience—optimization, parity features and various conveniences to make playing the game just that little bit better where it's needed, without complicating it excessively.

An exact mod list/resource list has not been provided since different mods have different update cycles as with game updates, and so alternatives/forks/testing releases maybe used or swapped in due course. The pack is based on Simply Optimised, Everything Voxy and my own tweaks.

![An image of a vast Minecraft world with unique biomes and shaders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Iy8MNQM3/images/41b38957794b25f6e86d7829017fcbedf34cd615.png)
